newsitem.title: USA: Global High Income Q2 net asset value rises.
newsitem.headline: Global High Income Q2 net asset value rises.

text.p: Global High Income Dollar Fund Inc said Friday its net asset value rose 7.78 percent in the second quarter compared with the previous quarter.

The fund, which invests in emerging market debt, said it cut back its holdings in Polish zloty-denominated securities holding during the quarter, while holding steady with its investments in Mexico, Argentina, Brazil and Russia.
The fund said it would closely follow exchange-rate developments in Asia and Eastern Europe in the wake of the Thai bath's drop against the dollar.
